name: – Johan Van Overtveldt – Draft Council decision
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision laying down the measures necessary for the implementation of Protocol No 37 on the financial consequences of the expiry of the ECSC Treaty and on the Research Fund for Coal and Steel, annexed to the Treaty on European Union and to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union and repealing Decision No 2003/76/EC
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees to a Council decision on how money left over from the old European Coal and Steel Community is handled. That fund now pays for research on coal and steel. The decision sets out the practical rules for running the fund and replaces an earlier decision from 2003. Parliament's role here is simply to give or refuse consent; it is not proposing changes of its own.

- What changes: the rules for running the coal and steel research fund are updated, replacing the 2003 decision.
- Who it affects: researchers and projects funded by the coal and steel research fund.
- What happens next: Parliament has given its consent, so the Council can now adopt the decision.
